title: Personalize Traffic Not Splitting According to Configured Variant Weights
alternate_search_terms: Personalize all traffic going to one variant
audience priority rule overriding variant weight

extracted_facts.problem: The customer configured a 50/50 traffic split between two variants, but nearly all traffic was going to only one variant.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The experience still had a leftover audience-priority rule from an earlier draft that forced one variant for a broad audience segment, overriding the weighted split for most visitors.
resolution_steps: Remove the leftover audience-priority rule from the experience configuration.
